items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to release claimed refund
items.quote:
überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von
49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: 'bis zum 27.11.2026'. 2026-11-27 falls on a Friday, a normal business day in NRW (no weekend or public-holiday adjustment needed). So the stated due date is taken as given.

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of an advance-fee / phishing scam: an unsolicited 'refund' is announced, and the recipient is asked to first pay a smaller 'processing fee' before receiving the (much larger) promised sum — a classic fraud pattern.

The payment account is an IBAN in Cyprus (CY...) for a sender claiming to handle German consumer energy refunds; legitimate German refund/authority processes do not require upfront fees paid to a foreign account.
The sender name 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie' is not a known German authority, regulator, or utility company, and the address given is in Nicosia, Cyprus, not Germany.
The letter uses urgency/pressure tactics ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig') to rush the recipient into paying quickly without verification — a common scam technique.

Recommend the recipient does NOT pay the requested fee, does not share bank details, and verifies independently (e.g. via the Verbraucherzentrale NRW or the Bundesnetzagentur) before taking any action; this letter should likely be reported as a scam.
